'''Heavy Hitting Hariyama''' (Japanese: '''VS ハリテヤマ''' ''VS {{tt|Hariteyama|Hariyama}}''), titled '''VS Hariyama''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 197th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 17th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}.

It is subtitled '''Counterattack Finale''' (Japanese: '''決着のカウンター''' ''Ending Counter'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Counter Strike''' in the Chuang Yi translation.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
[[Brawly]]'s newly [[Evolution|evolved]] {{p|Hariyama}} goes to attack once more. With [[Chic]] still stuck in the wall, Sapphire is at a disadvantage, but she commands Chic to try and block it. Although confident that he has won, Brawly's confidence is shattered when he sees his Hariyama falling down defeated.

Sapphire reveals that when Hariyama used {{m|Counter}} to do double the damage from Chic's first attack, Chic used {{m|Double Kick}} to deal a second hit to it. Sapphire reveals that she figured out that Brawly's Makuhita was going to evolve based on his mannerisms when they first met. Although surprised that he lost, Brawly awards Sapphire her second Badge, the {{badge|Knuckle}}.

Suddenly, a rumbling sound begins roaring outside at [[Granite Cave]]. Although Brawly tries to stop her from going, Sapphire worries about {{adv|Ruby}}'s safety. Despite Sapphire's protests of calling Ruby her friend, Brawly decides to let her go after him seeing how worried she is about Ruby.

Sapphire arrives at Granite Cave and begins searching for Ruby. Ruby quickly turns up alright and teases her by asking if she came to the cave to look for food to eat. Angry, Sapphire yells at Ruby who tells her that he didn't ask her to come and save him. Ruby also reveals that he met [[Steven Stone]], a person who helped him battle a group of [[wild Pokémon]] in the cave.

Sapphire quickly asks him where Steven went, and Ruby points to the direction where he left. She reveals that she was supposed to meet him and drags Ruby to go and find him. She jumps off a cliff, and the two land on {{p|Wailord|Lorry}} to go and chase after Steven.

The counter of the bet continues at 69 days.

==Major events==
* {{adv|Sapphire}} beats [[Brawly]] and earns the {{badge|Knuckle}}.
* Sapphire and {{adv|Ruby}} chase after {{Steven}}.
